# Deltempo

> Deltempo is a fast, portable, open-source Windows cleaner, app uninstaller, duplicate file finder, and NT memory optimizer for Windows 10 and 11. Zero telemetry, 100% local, MIT licensed.

- [Official Website](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/): Primary homepage, interactive simulator, and downloads
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Beso1227/Deltempo): Source code, issues, and community contributions
- [Download](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/download/): Standalone executable and WinGet installation
- [Documentation](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/docs/): Technical guide to 26+ scopes, safety tiers, and CLI commands
- [FAQ](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/faq/): Common questions on safety, GPU caches, NT memory, duplicate finder, and app uninstallation
- [Changelog](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/changelog/): Release notes and version history (including v1.8.0)

## Overview
Deltempo safely purges disposable system, developer, and browser caches, recovers gigabytes of disk space, thoroughly uninstalls desktop programs with leftover cleanup, detects byte-level duplicate files, provides an interactive storage treemap, provides startup intelligence, and trims inactive Windows memory working sets with zero telemetry.
Package identifier for Microsoft WinGet: `winget install Beso1227.Deltempo`

## Core Capabilities
- **26+ Cleaning Scopes**: System temp, driver installers, DirectX/GPU shader caches, browser caches, dev artifacts (NuGet, npm, pip, Cargo, Gradle), and crash dumps.
- **Byte-Level Duplicate File Finder**: 3-stage high-performance detection pipeline (exact size grouping, 4KB header prefix comparison, and SHA-256 cryptographic verification) with strict Windows system folder immunity.
- **Squarified Treemap Storage Visualizer**: Interactive nested graphical map utilizing the squarified treemap layout algorithm (Bruls, Huizing, van Wijk) for zero-dependency disk space drilldown.
- **Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) & Restore Point Manager**: Enumerate restore points, generate checkpoints before operations, and safely prune obsolete snapshots based on retention limits.
- **Scheduled Maintenance Automation & Explorer Context Menu**: Windows Task Scheduler integration for automated unattended cleanups and right-click folder cleaning directly in Windows File Explorer.
- **Low Disk Shield & Tray Guardian**: Proactive background tray telemetry alerts when free disk space falls below safety thresholds.
- **Deep Root App Uninstaller (v1.8.0)**: Powered by BCU engine; performs silent bulk removals, multi-drive root residual sweeps, registry and AppData leftover cleanup, and force-removals of corrupt/broken software.
- **Optional System Restore Points**: Pre-uninstall restore point creation is an optional toggle, turned off by default to conserve disk and avoid freezes.
- **Application & Startup Intelligence**: Answers "Will anything go wrong if I disable or uninstall this?" with 3-tier verdicts (SafeToDisable, CautionNeeded, EssentialKeep), offline heuristics, and multi-provider AI support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio).
- **Process Manager with Native Icons**: Real-time process inspection with live high-DPI icon extraction from running executables.
- **Chris Titus Tech WinUtil (CTT) 1-Click Launcher**: Built-in direct execution of the renowned Windows utility.
- **Native NT Memory Optimizer**: Standby list flushes and working set trims via `NtSetSystemInformation` and `EmptyWorkingSet`.
- **Multilingual RTL Architecture**: Full English, Arabic, Spanish, French, and German translation with native Right-to-Left (RTL) window flow and isolated numeric layouts.
- **Pro Eye-Comfort Themes**: Obsidian Titanium (Dark) and Porcelain Slate (Light) engineered for reduced eye strain and zero glare.
- **Zero Telemetry & 612 Automated Tests**: All operations run 100% locally; completely free and open-source under the MIT license with 612 automated tests enforcing 0 regressions.
